name: Gruntwork
tagline: Company swag people don't immediately donate.
positioning: Gruntwork is the swag platform for startups that would rather ship 50 great hoodies than 500 sad pens.

hero.h1: Swag so good your team steals it
hero.sub: Curated merch drops, zero minimums, and a warehouse that isn't your office closet. Design once, and we handle printing, packing, and worldwide shipping.

features.title: No minimums, ever
features.description: Order one hoodie for the new hire or a thousand for the conference. Same price energy.

features.title: Global swag closet
features.description: We store it, you send it. One click ships a welcome kit to any country your team hides in.

features.title: Taste firewall
features.description: Our curators reject items destined for the donation bin. Yes, that includes stress balls.

features.title: Auto welcome kits
features.description: Hook up your HR stack and every new hire gets a box before their first standup.

testimonials.quote: Our retention went up and I'm 60% sure it's the hoodies.
testimonials.name: Priya Natarajan

testimonials.quote: I used to spend Fridays in the post office. Now I spend them pretending to work, like everyone else.
testimonials.name: Marcus Webb

testimonials.quote: The taste firewall rejected our CEO's slogan idea. Worth every penny.
testimonials.name: Jenny Okafor

pricing.blurb: Pay per item. Dip a toe in the swag lagoon.
For teams that onboard humans regularly.
Merch as a personality. Conference mode unlocked.

homepage.footerBlurb: Gruntwork makes company swag people actually wear. The stress balls didn't make it. They know what they did.
